description: Convert spring rate and motion ratio into wheel rate for setup comparisons. Calculates from measured inputs without authentication and does not read or save account data. Wheel rate compares spring changes. It does not account for bars, bump stops, tires, or aero load.

cornerWeight.description: Corner weight (lb in imperial; kg in metric)

springRate.description: Spring rate (lb/in in imperial; N/mm in metric)
